label: prop:wedderburn-as-noncomm-fourier
title: The Wedderburn--Artin mass sum is the inverse non-commutative Fourier transform on $H_n(q)$
html:
Statement. The character expansion driving the three-invariant mass formula operates identically to the inverse non-commutative Fourier transform on the semisimple Hecke algebra H_n(q).

The mechanism and its role in the mass formula are described in the non-commutative-Fourier reading.
heading: Proposition
